verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, LBG 83401, 1971). Discogs lists 6 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by The Gramophone Co. Ltd.

notes.text:
Fully laminated gatefold sleeve.
Black Liberty labels without 'Made in England'.
Small space between 'Engineer: Martin Birch' & '1. CHERRY RED' and different font on labels compared to this:

.

Labels:
Produced by T.S. McPhee for Zak Productions 
℗ 1971
A Product of Liberty/UA Records Ltd. England

Sleeve:
Produced by Tony (T.S.) McPhee for Zak Productions 
Recorded during November 1970 at De Lane Lea Studios, London, England.
Printed and made by the E. J. Day Group, London and Bedford
A product of Liberty -- United Artists Records Ltd. London, England

There is a similar version,

, with label differences.

Runouts are stamped.
